title: QGIS to CEA Conversion Script
description: A Python script for exporting building polygons from QGIS to City Energy Analyst (CEA) compatible shapefiles. Automatically converts coordinate systems, validates geometries, and generates zone.shp, site.shp, and typology.dbf files required for CEA energy simulations.
